description: This file is a Yocto recipe for building and deploying the Xen hypervisor, including configuration, compilation, installation, and deployment steps.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Configures the Xen build, handling configuration fragments and generating the .config file if necessary.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Compiles the Xen hypervisor using make with specific environment variables.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the compiled Xen hypervisor into the destination directory.

methods.name: do_deploy
methods.description: Deploys Xen binaries and related files to the deployment directory, ensuring they match the build stage.
